reported_case.latest_screenshot: Some images completed on Muse 04 and Muse 09; other cards show unreadable media or a 250-second wait limit.

validation.limitations: The actual failing Muse link and new error JSON were not provided. Tests use fixture services and cannot establish universal compatibility or guarantee remote image generation within 250 seconds.
changes: Image-only discovery of extensionless View/Open image links and image filenames in visible link text.
Image download buttons in separate native cards are matched only by unique bounded CLIP attribution.
Same-origin image links can use the browser download action with the original signed URL when fetch fails.

A timed out or cancelled image download cannot be assigned to a later scene. Native actions on that uncertain page require a full Muse reload; direct image/video URL reads and other accounts continue.
No automatic generation replay, fake resolution or placeholder image completion.
validation.preserved_modes: Default one account/one lane and ten accounts/ten lanes; expanded account/lane choices, six slots per account, source names, multi-file TXT/SRT queues, proxies and saved results.
validation.windows_test_lifecycle_fix: An existing composer-readiness check hit its 10-second whole-browser test budget. Its lifecycle budget is now 30 seconds, with timing diagnostics; the inner 800 ms composer probe, draft/no-reload/no-submit assertions and 250-second application limit are unchanged.

bulk_delete_checks.scope: All video results across batches, versions and hidden scenes; sync selection and current output mode do not restrict deletion.
bulk_delete_checks.atomicity: One media-store transaction; queue history is retained unchanged and unavailable results are derived without automatic resubmission.
bulk_delete_checks.preserves: Image/reference bytes and URLs, prompt/name/selection metadata, queue history, downloaded disk files and service history.
bulk_delete_checks.lifecycle: Deletion is blocked during generation, preparation, recovery, queue feed/import, downloads and another deletion. UI and Blob URL cleanup follow successful transaction commit.

validation.required_windows_checks: All required outcomes passed before packaging; the packaged EXE then passed startup, portable flows, media recovery, native attachments, separate account videos, image controls/queues, three-account images and bulk video deletion.

user_added_feature.request: Add synchronized deletion of all generated videos.
user_added_feature.confirmed_scope: All video results throughout the tool, not only selected synchronization slots.
user_added_feature.preserved: Images, references, prompts, names, accounts, TXT/SRT queue/history, downloaded disk files and Muse service history.
user_added_feature.native_test: Three stored video versions including an old version and hidden scene 300 are deleted. Cancel preserves all records. One image remains visible after restart at the same studio origin; a previously downloaded MP4 remains byte-identical. No generation request is sent.
